title: 第13章 裂骨魔猿煞剑残图第14章 裂骨魔猿煞剑残图下
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
染血的骨牌冰冷刺骨，猩红的“叁拾柒”
数字如同凝固的鲜血。
那半张残破的兽皮地图被阴九幽残存的魂力牢牢“攥”
在骨指间。
断裂暗金小剑的图案，仿佛带着某种魔力，勾动着万魂幡核心那点微弱魂火的剧烈跳动，更引动了他骨骼深处那丝源自金甲骸骨王魂的本源煞气！
一股强烈的、近乎本能的渴望在阴九幽冰冷的意识中翻腾——
找到它！
吞噬它！
那柄断裂的暗金巨剑，是金甲王魂力量的核心象征！
若能寻得残骸，甚至只是碎片…
对万魂幡的修复、对他自身力量的恢复，都将是难以想象的巨大补益！
这地图，是希望！
更是催命符！
在这万魔环伺的焦土死狱，任何一点价值，都可能引来更恐怖的觊觎！
阴九幽强压下心头的悸动，残破的骨架如同最吝啬的守财奴，疯狂汲取着万魂幡反哺来的、源自血狼神魂炼化的每一丝精纯血煞魂力。
暗金骨骼上的裂痕在微弱黑气的缠绕下，以极其缓慢的速度弥合着。
万魂幡的魂火也稳定了一丝，不再如风中残烛般随时会熄灭。
然而，这片刻的喘息，注定是风暴前的宁静。
“吼——！
！”

一声震耳欲聋、充满暴虐与毁灭气息的咆哮，如同惊雷般在巨大的环形囚笼中炸响！
整个焦土死狱都仿佛在这咆哮声中颤抖！
灼热的地面砂砾簌簌滚动！
看台上那些慵懒、残忍的目光瞬间被点燃，爆发出更加兴奋嗜血的呼喊！
“来了！
是裂骨！”
“哈哈，有好戏看了！
那骨头架子刚喘口气，裂骨就忍不住了！”
“裂骨魔猿！
撕碎他！
把他的骨头一根根嚼碎！”
沉重的脚步声如同战鼓擂动，从囚笼另一端传来。
一个庞大、狰狞的身影，在两名守卫傀儡的“押送”
下，拖着沉重的黑红锁链，一步步踏入焦灼的战场。
那是一头身高近三丈的恐怖魔猿！
它并非纯粹的血肉之躯，全身覆盖着暗红色、如同熔岩冷却后形成的粗糙骨甲！
关节处生长着尖锐的骨刺，闪烁着金属般的寒光！
巨大的头颅上，獠牙外翻，一双灯笼大小的猩红眼眸燃烧着纯粹的暴虐与毁灭欲望，死死锁定着靠在岩壁上的阴九幽！
它每走一步，焦黑的地面都留下一个深深的、燃烧着暗红火星的脚印！
气息狂暴、混乱，赫然达到了筑基巅峰，甚至半只脚已经踏入了金丹的门槛！

正是这焦土死狱低阶囚笼中凶名赫赫的“角斗士”
——裂骨魔猿！
content_en:
The blood-stained dominoes are bone-chilling, the scarlet "Three Shiqi"
Numbers are like coagulated blood.
The half-broken animal skin map was firmly "grabbed" by Yin Jiuyou's remaining soul power.
Between the fingers.
The pattern of the broken dark gold sword seemed to carry some kind of magic power, arousing the violent beating of the weak soul fire at the core of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, and also triggered the original evil energy deep in his bones originating from the soul of the Golden Armored Skeleton King!
A strong, almost instinctive desire surged in Yin Jiuyou's cold consciousness——
Find it!
Devour it!
That broken dark gold sword is the core symbol of the power of the Golden Armored King's Soul!
If the wreckage could be found, or even just fragments...
The repair of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner and the restoration of his own strength will be unimaginably huge benefits!
This map is hope!
It’s even more of a reminder!
In this scorched earth hell surrounded by thousands of demons, any value may attract more terrifying covetousness!
Yin Jiuyou suppressed the throbbing in his heart. The broken skeleton was like the stingiest miser, frantically absorbing every ounce of pure blood soul power that was fed back by the Ten Thousand Soul Banner and derived from the refining of the blood wolf soul.
The cracks on the dark gold bones were healed at an extremely slow speed by the entanglement of weak black energy.
The soul fire of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner has also stabilized a bit, no longer extinguishing at any time like a candle in the wind.
However, this moment of respite is destined to be the calm before the storm.
“Hoo—!
! "
A deafening roar, full of violence and destruction, exploded like thunder in the huge ring-shaped cage!
The entire Scorched Earth Death Prison seemed to tremble at the roar!
The hot ground is filled with gravel!
The lazy and cruel eyes in the stands were instantly ignited, and they burst into even more excited and bloodthirsty shouts!
"Coming!
It's a broken bone! "
“Haha, there’s a good show to watch!
As soon as the skeleton took a breath, the cracked bones couldn't hold back anymore! "
"Bone-cracking Demonic Ape!
Tear him apart!
Chew his bones one by one! "
The sound of heavy footsteps was like the beating of war drums, coming from the other end of the cage.
A huge, ferocious figure was "escorted" by two guard puppets
Down, dragging the heavy black and red chains, step by step into the scorching battlefield.
It was a terrifying demon ape nearly three feet tall!
It is not purely flesh and blood, its whole body is covered in dark red, like rough bone armor formed after cooling lava!
There are sharp bone spurs growing on the joints, shining with a metallic cold light!
On the huge head, the fangs were turned outwards, and a pair of scarlet eyes the size of lanterns burned with pure desire for violence and destruction, locked tightly on Yin Jiuyou who was leaning on the rock wall!
Every step it takes, it leaves a deep footprint burning with dark red sparks on the charred ground!
The aura was violent and chaotic, and it suddenly reached the peak of foundation building, and even half of its feet had already stepped into the threshold of the golden elixir!
It is the famous "Gladiator" in the low-level cage of the Scorched Earth Death Prison.
——Bone-breaking Demonic Ape!
